caption: The drawing depicts a textile or fabric swatch positioned within a rectangular border. The textile features a checkerboard pattern composed of large squares in red, brown, and tan, intersected by horizontal and vertical stripes in blue, white, and tan. The blue stripes contain recurring white geometric motifs, while the brown and red squares are filled with small, repetitive decorative patterns in contrasting colors. Each intersection of the stripes forms a distinct contrasting pattern. The top of the textile is folded over, revealing a fringe of threads in dark brown, red, white, and blue. The uppermost portion of the fold primarily displays crisscross and geometric patterns in red, brown, white, blue, and tan. The background is plain and beige, and a thin black outline frames the drawing.
title: Coverlet (Blanket)
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
